title: The Rumble of the Road
story:
The descent down the limestone hill was quick and sun-drenched, the dry gravel crunching underfoot as the hilltop wind faded into the warm, heavy air of the valley. At the base of the ridge, James and Nico stepped out from the shadow of the rocks and onto the wide gravel shoulder of the southern highway. Dense, emerald walls of sugarcane towered on both sides of the road, their long leafy tassels swaying slightly in the heat.

It did not take long for the quiet of the morning to shatter. With a deep, mechanical roar that vibrated through the ground, a massive blue supply truck surged past on the asphalt pavement, kicking up a swirling cloud of beige dust and dry leaves. James immediately crouched low beside a concrete kilometer marker, tucking Nico safely behind his arm until the rush of displaced air subsided. Nico peeked out, his large ears twitching as the tail lights vanished into the shimmering heat haze down the road.

Learning the rhythm of the highway, James kept them moving along the grassy ditch several paces back from the asphalt edge. The sugarcane fields smelled sweet and earthy, damp beneath the high green canopy of stalks. Resting near an irrigation culvert, James spotted a cracked section of freshly harvested sugarcane that had tumbled off a farm cart. Picking up a splintered piece, he squeezed a drop of clear, sugary juice onto his palm, offering a taste to Nico before nibbling a bit himself.

As the midday sun swung overhead, the two travelers established a comfortable pace, navigating around thorny briars and loose stones along the field border. Every few minutes another rumble announced an approaching motor-carriage, but James had learned to spot their shadows on the power lines above long before they arrived. With the sweet taste of cane lingering and the steady ribbon of road stretching south before them, they marched forward into the sunlit valley.
location: Highway shoulder by sugarcane fields south of San Antonio del Río
